```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.NCBI.T2TCHM13v2.0)

source('~/CRISPR-KO-GuideRefine/GuideRefine_functions.R')
source("./00_CRISPR-KO-library-survey-functions.R")
```

# Import data containing removed genes from each library

```{r}

removed_genes <- read_csv("../data/biogrid_crispr_ko_data/important_data/removed_genes_all_library.csv")

```

# UpSet plot for commonality of removed genes between 5 libraries

```{r}

removed_gene_list_combined <- list(
  Avana = na.omit(removed_genes[["avana_removed_genes_all"]]),
  Brunello = na.omit(removed_genes[["brunello_removed_genes_all"]]),
  Toronto = na.omit(removed_genes[["toronto_removed_genes_all"]]),
  Yusa = na.omit(removed_genes[["yusa_removed_genes_all"]]),
  Jacquere = na.omit(removed_genes[["jacquere_removed_genes_all"]])
)
```

# 200 Genes removed across all libraries

## What are these genes?

```{r}

removed_genes_all_libraries <- Reduce(intersect, removed_gene_list_combined)
# manually replace one gene that is in HGNC as previous symbol
removed_genes_all_libraries <- replace(removed_genes_all_libraries, 5, "BKGD")

hgnc <- read_tsv(url("https://storage.googleapis.com/public-download-files/hgnc/tsv/tsv/hgnc_complete_set.txt"))
hgnc <- hgnc %>% filter(symbol %in% removed_genes_all_libraries)

```

```{r}
gene_annot_granges <- readRDS(file = "~/CRISPR-KO-GuideRefine/annotation_file/T2T-CHM13v2.0_gene_annot_granges.rds")
```
